query: MATCH (n {repository_id: 'leafcutter', current: true}) WHERE $component IN n.components OPTIONAL MATCH p = (n)-[r:COMPONENT_MEMBERSHIP {current: true}]->(c:Component {repository_id: 'leafcutter', current: true}) WHERE c.name = $component RETURN n, p LIMIT 500
limitation: Aura resets the legend filter to All after reload; choose In Scene to hide categories absent from the scene. The free default perspective lists bookkeeping categories under All. The saved query excludes bookkeeping nodes and retired generations.
